## Statement

$$ \forall n \in \mathbb{N},\; 0 + n = n $$

## Hypotheses

- **H1.** $n$ ranges over the naturals.

## Why it was raised

A settled private entry with a Lean file, so the release path has something real
to move: one private-only evidence row that must be dropped, and one naming a
Lean path that must follow its file across.

## Current notes

Closed, and ready to release.
